DomainConfig.title:
=============================================================================
 DOMAIN CONFIGURATION PROTO
 =============================================================================
 Defines configuration for root domains (e.g., getHarsh.in, causality.in).
 Inherits all defaults from ecosystem.proto and can override/extend them.

 Key Features:
 - Schema.org entity definition for the domain
 - Page-level schema configuration
 - Policy page overrides with granular control
 - Theme, visual effects, and feature configuration

 Related Documentation:
 - Implementation Examples: ../SCHEMA-ORG-EXAMPLES.md#configuration-examples
 - Inheritance Rules: ../SCHEMA-ORG-EXAMPLES.md#inheritance--overrides
 - Configuration Guide: ../CONFIG.md
 =============================================================================

 - Policy pages with hierarchical override capability

website.config.gtm.GTMConfig.title:
=============================================================================
 GOOGLE TAG MANAGER CONFIGURATION PROTO
 =============================================================================
 Defines comprehensive GTM integration for the ecosystem with entity-aware
 tracking, multi-touch attribution, and consent mode v2 support.

 This schema enables:
 - Entity-specific GTM containers (RTEPL vs DSPL)
 - Cross-domain tracking across the ecosystem
 - GA4 enhanced ecommerce and conversions
 - Custom event tracking with data layer
 - Consent mode v2 integration
 - Server-side tagging support

 Related Documentation:
 - Implementation Guide: ../GTM-EXAMPLES.md
 - Mappings: gtm-mappings.yml
 - Parent Schema: ecosystem.proto
 =============================================================================
